2607.10245.title: PTEI: Integrating Personality Traits to Enhance Emotional Intelligence in Large Language Models
2607.10245.paper_summary: Despite advances in Emotional Intelligence (EI), Large Language Models (LLMs) still significantly underperform humans in complex emotional reasoning. This gap originates partly from the limited incorporation of individual differences, particularly personality traits, which are fundamental to human emotional inference. To address this, we propose PTEI, a novel framework for integrating Personality Traits into Emotional Intelligence tasks using LLMs. In PTEI, MBTI and OCEAN personality traits are first extracted directly from the given emotional scenarios and then utilized as contextual knowledge within personality-aware prompts, guiding LLMs to accurately infer emotions and their underlying causes. To ensure optimal contextual grounding, we employ Contrastive Learning to construct an optimized retrieval system that surfaces emotionally and personally aligned scenarios, enhancing reasoning quality. Extensive experiments on established EI benchmarks show that PTEI enhances the Emotional Understanding (EU) capabilities of various LLMs, with the strongest improvement observed in GPT models. Combining PTEI with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning yields an additional 4 percent increase in accuracy. These findings underscore PTEI's contribution toward advancing AI systems with more sophisticated social and psychological grounding.
2607.10245.paper_summary_zh: 儘管情感智力（EI）已取得進展，大型語言模型（LLMs）在複雜情感推理方面仍顯著低於人類。這一差距部分源於對個體差異的有限納入，特別是人格特質，這對於人類情感推斷至關重要。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了PTEI，一個將人格特質整合進情感智力任務的創新框架，使用LLMs。在PTEI中，MBTI和OCEAN人格特質首先直接從給定的情感場景中提取，然後作為上下文知識用於人格感知提示，指導LLMs準確推斷情感及其潛在原因。為了確保最佳的上下文基礎，我們採用對比學習來構建一個優化的檢索系統，該系統能夠呈現情感和個人上相符的場景，提升推理質量。在已建立的EI基準上進行的大量實驗顯示，PTEI增強了各種LLMs的情感理解（EU）能力，尤其是在GPT模型中觀察到最強的改善。將PTEI與思維鏈（CoT）推理結合，準確度再增加4%。這些發現強調了PTEI在推進具有更複雜社會和心理基礎的AI系統方面的貢獻。
